     sum(CASE WHEN e.is_task = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS task_count
UNWIND mood_signals AS ms
WITH total_exchanges, task_count,
     [ms IN COLLECT(ms) | {mood: ms, count: COUNT(ms)}] AS mood_signal_counts
MATCH (c)-[:CONTAINS]->(e)-[:DISCUSSED]->(t:Topic)
WITH total_exchanges, task_count, mood_signal_counts,
     collect(DISTINCT t.name) as top_topics_unsorted,
     [g IN COLLECT((e)-[:ACTIVATED]->(gn:GridNode)) | gn.name] AS grid_nodes
MATCH (c)-[:CONTAINS]->(e)-[:INVOLVES]->(p:Person)
WITH total_exchanges, task_count, mood_signal_counts,
     top_topics_unsorted, grid_nodes,
     collect(DISTINCT p.name) as people_mentioned
UNWIND top_topics_unsorted AS topic_name
WITH total_exchanges, task_count, mood_signal_counts, people_mentioned,
     [topic IN COLLECT(topic_name) | {name: topic, count: COUNT(topic)}] AS topics_with_counts,
     grid_nodes
MATCH (c)-[:CONTAINS]->(e)-[:ACTIVATED]->(gn:GridNode)
WITH total_exchanges, task_count, mood_signal_counts, people_mentioned,
     topics_with_counts,
     [grid IN COLLECT(gn.name) | {name: grid, count: COUNT(grid)}] AS grids_with_counts
RETURN total_exchanges,
       [topic IN apoc.coll.sortSlice(topics_with_counts, 'count', false)[..5] | topic.name] AS top_topics,
       [grid IN apoc.coll.sortSlice(grids_with_counts, 'count', false)[..5] | grid.name] AS grid_activations,
       people_mentioned[..10] AS people_mentioned,
       mood_signal_counts AS mood_signals,
       task_count
